newsitem.title: VATICAN: Former U.S. president Bush meets Pope at Vatican.
newsitem.headline: Former U.S. president Bush meets Pope at Vatican.

text.p: Former U.S. president George Bush met Pope John Paul at the Vatican on Friday during a visit to Italy.
The Vatican said the audience was private and no details would be released about what was discussed.
Bush also met Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi on Thursday to discuss a range of topics including the situation in Albania, European monetary union and the Middle East.
Political sources said the two men talked in English for about 45 minutes and also discussed less weighty issues such as a recent parachute jump made by Bush.
The former Republican president was due to attend a conference on "strategies for peace" in Milan later on Friday.
Former Russian leader Mikhail Gorbachev, former U.N. secretary general Javier Perez de Cuellar and former Swedish prime minister Ingvar Carlsson were also due to take part.
